summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of SIUjang Document Manager. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed covering sample creation, content-aware analyze (dynamic ranges, Spesifikasi Teknik Mesin spans 4-5), metadata (PLTD detected), documents update + corrections recorded, split, output PDF fetch, ZIP download, page image, original PDF, templates seeded (LHPP PLTD/PLTU/PLTS) and full templates CRUD. Frontend: end-to-end flow works - sample -> analyze -> detection table with 9 rows and confidence/status badges, select-all/toggle updates selected-count, edit dialog saves, preview dialog with main image loads, add-doc adds a row, split produces results with download-all enabled, readiness checklist visible, metadata panel populated, template drawer shows all 3 seeded templates, theme toggle button clickable.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid=theme-toggle-btn] did not change documentElement.className (stayed 'light'). Dark mode may not be wired correctly or uses a different attribute/storage. Please verify by manually toggling and confirming a class like 'dark' is applied and styles change.

Clicking [data-testid=delete-btn-0] did not visibly reduce the row count in automated test (10 -> 10). Possibly awaits a confirm dialog that wasn't captured; verify a confirmation flow (Hapus/Ya) exists and works.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (React console warnings). Add <DialogDescription> to EditDocDialog, PreviewDialog and TemplateDrawer sheets for a11y.

action_items: Verify dark mode toggle actually applies 'dark' class or theme change
Verify delete-doc confirm flow reduces row count
Add DialogDescription to dialogs for a11y warnings
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - should migrate to lifespan handler in FastAPI >=0.109
Storage local_cache_path is used for repeated reads - fine but ensure it's created for both sample and upload paths (verified working)
Corrections endpoint has no pagination - fine for MVP but should paginate at scale
template Create/Update accepts client-supplied id in body which could allow duplicates on PUT upsert; POST should ignore client id (currently uses default_factory OK).
seed_data_creation: Sample project created via POST /api/projects/sample; test templates prefixed TEST_ (deleted after use)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing (11 tests). Frontend flow works end-to-end. Two low-priority UI items to verify (theme toggle and delete confirmation). Use POST /api/projects/sample or the sample-btn to seed. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py.
